_meta.name: audit-emitter-poc
_meta.purpose: Phase 3 proof-of-concept: migrates 'Memory: Skill Discovery' to use the kernel n8n-audit-emitter template.
differences_from_source: Added 'Build Audit Row' Code node after 'Skill Discovery'
Added 'POST kernel.audit_emit' HTTP node after 'Build Audit Row'
Skill Discovery output is passed as payload.summary into the audit row
trace_id is generated per cron firing (no upstream webhook to inherit from)
deployment_steps: 1. Set KERNEL_AUDIT_TOKEN on the n8n instance (via env or n8n credential).
2. Set KERNEL_AUDIT_ENDPOINT to the governance-plugin audit listener URL (default http://localhost:5681/audit/emit).
3. Import via n8n_create_workflow (or direct API) against http://localhost:5679.
5. Trigger manually or wait for the weekly cron (Sunday 6am).
6. Verify a row appears in governance-plugin/state/audit.db with event_type='memory.skill_discovery.cron_completed' and parent_id matching the F-12 pattern.
